back_translation: Ephraim surrounds Me with lies, and the house of Israel surrounds Me with deceit; but Judah still walks with God and is faithful to the Holy One.
Ephraim feeds on the wind and pursues the east wind all day long; he multiplies lies and violence; he makes a covenant with Assyria and carries oil to Egypt.
The LORD has a lawsuit against Judah, and He will punish Jacob according to his ways and repay him according to his deeds.
In the womb he grasped his brother's heel, and when he was grown he struggled with God.
He struggled with the angel and prevailed; he wept and sought His favor; at Bethel he found Him, and there He spoke with us—
that is, the LORD God of Hosts; the LORD is His renowned name.
But as for you, return to your God; keep steadfast love and justice, and wait for your God continually.
He is a merchant who holds dishonest scales in his hand; he loves to oppress and extort.
Ephraim boasts, 'I have become rich; I have found wealth for myself; in all my labors they will find no iniquity or sin in me.'
But I am the LORD your God ever since you were in the land of Egypt; I will make you dwell in tents again, as in the days of the appointed feast.
I spoke through the prophets, multiplied visions, and gave parables through the prophets.
Is there iniquity in Gilead? They are utterly worthless; in Gilgal they sacrifice bulls, and their altars are like heaps of stones in the furrows of a field.
Jacob fled to the land of Aram; Israel served another to gain a wife, and for a wife he kept sheep.
The LORD used a prophet to bring Israel up out of Egypt, and by a prophet he was protected and kept.
Ephraim has provoked bitter anger, so his Lord will leave his bloodguilt upon him and will repay him for his contempt.
